advice.roomRead: Roster 10: Picks twice at 30-31 with TE, QB, RB and WR all high needs - the only team that can take Bowers.
advice.strategy: Balanced Nacua/Barkley core, now buying the one genuinely separating TE before the 15.7-point cliff, with RB/WR depth restocked at 32 and 49.
advice.firstSeedDeviationReason: Only fsGap 1 past First Seed's best available - effectively following the board.
advice.strongestAlternativeWhy: Pickens is First Seed's best available (rank 28, fsGap 0), top projected WR left at 151.7, and fills a starting WR slot.
advice.strongestCounterargument: Juancho's sim puts Bowers at simGap -12.7 versus Javonte Williams at 0, and Bowers/Pickens are BOTH available in 55.7% of runs with Pickens surviving 78.3% - so we could plausibly get the TE at 32 anyway.
advice.whyRecommendationStillWins: The 55.7% both-survive is a coin flip on the only TE with a 15.7-pt cliff behind him; if he goes we replace him with a ~105-pt TE. If Pickens goes instead (21.7%), Rice/Higgins/McMillan sit within 5 pts at WR. Asymmetric downside favors Bowers now.
advice.expectedNextPickPlan: At 32 take the best of Pickens/Nabers/Rice at WR, or Javonte Williams/Judkins if the WR tier thins; RB tier 9 (6.5 expected survivors) should still be there at 49.
